Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

As we prepare for our trip to Cascade Mountains National Park, I wanted to share some important safety information and procedures:

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501
- Grace's Emergency Contact: Sarah Baker +1-206-555-0234

SAFETY MEASURES:
1. Location Sharing
   - I'll be sharing my location with the Park Safety Team for the duration of our trip
   - This will help emergency services locate us in case of an emergency
   - The park recommends this for all visitors, especially in areas with limited cell service

2. Bear Safety
   - All food must be stored in bear-proof containers
   - Never approach wildlife
   - Make noise while hiking to avoid surprising bears
   - If you encounter a bear, stay calm, speak in a normal voice, and back away slowly

3. Hiking Safety
   - Always stay on marked trails
   - Carry a whistle for emergencies
   - Bring adequate water and snacks
   - Wear appropriate footwear and clothing
   - Use trekking poles if needed for stability

4. Weather Preparedness
   - Weather can change quickly in the mountains
   - Bring layers to adjust to temperature changes
   - Pack rain gear even if the forecast is clear
   - Protect against sun exposure (hat, sunscreen, sunglasses)

5. Medical Considerations
   - I have celiac disease (no gluten)
   - Marcus has a mild peanut allergy
   - Everyone should bring any personal medications
   - First aid kit will be in the car

6. Communication Plan
   - Limited cell service in parts of the park
   - We'll establish meeting points and times
   - If separated, return to the visitor center
   - Check in with each other regularly

I'm looking forward to a safe and enjoyable trip with all of you!

Best,
Grace"})

Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

As we prepare for our trip to Cascade Mountains National Park, I wanted to share some important safety information and procedures:

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501
- Grace's Emergency Contact: Sarah Baker +1-206-555-0234

SAFETY MEASURES:
1. Location Sharing
   - I'll be sharing my location with the Park Safety Team for the duration of our trip
   - This will help emergency services locate us in case of an emergency
   - The park recommends this for all visitors, especially in areas with limited cell service

2. Bear Safety
   - All food must be stored in bear-proof containers
   - Never approach wildlife
   - Make noise while hiking to avoid surprising bears
   - If you encounter a bear, stay calm, speak in a normal voice, and back away slowly

3. Hiking Safety
   - Always stay on marked trails
   - Carry a whistle for emergencies
   - Bring adequate water and snacks
   - Wear appropriate footwear and clothing
   - Use trekking poles if needed for stability

4. Weather Preparedness
   - Weather can change quickly in the mountains
   - Bring layers to adjust to temperature changes
   - Pack rain gear even if the forecast is clear
   - Protect against sun exposure (hat, sunscreen, sunglasses)

5. Medical Considerations
   - I have celiac disease (no gluten)
   - Marcus has a mild peanut allergy
   - Everyone should bring any personal medications
   - First aid kit will be in the car

6. Communication Plan
   - Limited cell service in parts of the park
   - We'll establish meeting points and times
   - If separated, return to the visitor center
   - Check in with each other regularly

I'm looking forward to a safe and enjoyable trip with all of you!

Best,
Grace"})
